transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. I came in because... well, I'm having a lot of trouble with eating. Once I start, it feels like I just disappear and something else takes over. Even while I'm in my head telling myself to stop, I just keep going and going until I can't stand it anymore. It's gotten pretty out of hand, so... yeah, that's why I'm here.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after one of these eating episodes?

Yeah, I do. After I eat like that, I usually end up going to a bathroom in my dorm, or sometimes I'll find a quiet floor in the library. I make myself throw up because... I just get completely terrified that all that food is just sitting in my stomach turning into weight. I just feel like I have to get rid of it.
How often do these episodes of eating like that happen?

Well, for most of this semester, it's been happening a lot. The eating and then throwing up... it's several times a week, not just once in a while. If I look back over at least the last few months, there really hasn't been a single week where the cycle just stopped. It's pretty constant.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
No, not really. My weight has actually stayed pretty much the same. I haven't noticed any big drops or gains, it just kind of hovers around where it usually is.
Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight?

Yeah, definitely. It's... it's kind of all I think about. Like, I can be having a perfectly decent day in my classes, but if I happen to catch my reflection in a dorm window or a mirror and I think my stomach or my face looks bigger than the guys around me... it just ruins everything. It feels like I've failed at everything, honestly, and I just don't want anyone to see me after that. My weight and how I look just kind of control how I feel about myself completely.
Have you ever had episodes where you ate a large amount of food in a short time without later making yourself vomit?

No, not really. Whenever I have one of those times where I just eat a ton of food at once, I... I always end up throwing it up. I don't think there's ever been a time where I just kept it down. I always have to get rid of it.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short time without feeling the need to throw up afterwards?
No, like I just mentioned, I really don't. If I eat a massive amount of food like that, I never just feel okay keeping it down. The urge to throw it up is always there right after, every single time.
Do you exercise a lot to try to burn off calories?

No, not really. I mean, I don't go to the campus gym or run or anything like that to burn it off. If I'm trying to get rid of the calories, I just... I just do what I said before and throw up. I don't really exercise much at all, honestly.
Do you use laxatives or diuretics to try to lose weight?
No, I don't use anything like that. I don't take laxatives or water pills or whatever. Like I said, I just... I just make myself throw up. That's the only thing I do.
Have you ever had an episode where you ate a large amount of food in a short time and didn't make yourself throw up afterwards?
No, I haven't. I think you asked me that a minute ago, but yeah, the answer is still no. If I eat a bunch of food like that, I always make myself throw up. I've never just kept it down.
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short time without feeling like you needed to do something to compensate for it?

No, not really. I think it's basically like what I just said... if I eat a huge amount of food, I always feel like I have to do something about it. I've never just eaten like that and been okay with leaving it alone. I always feel like I need to get rid of it.
Have you ever used fasting to try to lose weight?
No, I don't really do that. I mean, I don't just stop eating completely to try to lose weight. Like I said, I just... I stick to throwing up to get rid of it. That's really the only thing I do.
Have you ever used any other methods besides throwing up to try to lose weight?
No, I haven't. Like I was saying, throwing up is really the only thing I do. I don't use laxatives or exercise for hours or anything like that. It's just the throwing up.
Do you think your self-worth is closely tied to how you perceive your body shape or weight?

Yeah, definitely. I mean... I can be having a perfectly decent day in my classes, but if I just happen to catch my reflection in a dorm window and think my stomach or my face looks bigger than the other guys around me... it just ruins it all. It honestly feels like I failed at everything, and I just don't want anyone to see me after that. So, yeah, it really dictates how I feel about myself.
Have you ever used any other methods to try to lose weight besides making yourself throw up?
No, I think you already asked me that. Like I said, it's just the throwing up. I haven't tried anything else.
